content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICDS Pathalgaon Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICDS Pathalgaon to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICDS Pathalgaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Anganwadi Karyakarta / Sahayika posts is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: For the Anganwadi Karyakarta position, a minimum of 12th pass is required. For the Anganwadi Sahayika role, a minimum of 8th pass is sufficient.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Anganwadi Karyakarta / Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for these posts is between a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 44 years.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with one or more years of experience as an Anganwadi Karyakarta or Sahayika are eligible for a 3-year age relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available for the posts of Anganwadi Karyakarta and Anganwadi Sahayika.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves merit evaluation by a committee, followed by the provisional list upload, a period for claims and objections, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for ICDS Pathalgaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Anganwadi Karyakarta and Sahayika are offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please check the provided links for direct access.
